blocks.text: Not everyone will understand the version of you that's healing. The quiet. The distance. The way you say no now. The way you don't explain as much. That's okay. You're not becoming cold. You're becoming careful with the parts of you that were never protected before. Let them call it changing. You know it's growing.

caption:
You're not becoming cold. You're becoming careful. 🖤
Who needs to read this today? Send it to them.
Save it for when someone says you've changed.
